cc:Work.dc:title: latency-comparison
cc:Work.dc:description: The client stays on a separate host. Full gRPC with separate processes is compared with lightweight messaging and in-process Go adaptation, then separate deletion and installation submissions are combined. Each application request carries one connection target. Mean SDK and remaining intervals sum to mean API latency; p99 values show the range across repeated runs. Protocol and service changes cannot be attributed separately.
